title: Control flow [If]
description:
In C#, you can check certain conditions on booleans using somthing called _Control Flow_. Control Flow just checks if a boolean condition is true, and if it is true, it runs the code.
---
The most basic type of control flow is the `if` statement.
#### Syntax:
```cs
if (condition) {
    code
}
```
---
It's that simple. A condition is just anything that evaluates to a boolean.
### Assignment:
The ChronoShard Team needs a way to check if the player is dead or dying. Write two `if` statements. One that checks the is_dead condition and prints "You have died" if it is true, and one that checks `is_dying` and prints "You're dying" if it is true.
hint: To evaluate just a boolean in a codition, just write the variables name, so to evaluate a boolean called flag in a `if` statement, you just type `if (flag)` and that will run if true
